footer.tagline: Medicine anytime anywhere. Online medical consultations with locally-registered doctors in the markets where we operate.
footer.newsletterDesc: Monthly health updates on new countries, doctors, and health topics. No spam.
footer.newsletterPrivacy: We respect your privacy. Unsubscribe anytime.
footer.disclaimer: Online consultations are not a substitute for emergency care. If you need urgent help, call 112 or your local emergency number. Information on this website is general guidance; prescriptions, certificates, referrals and next steps depend on clinical assessment and are issued at the treating clinician's discretion.

cookie.title: Cookie preferences
cookie.body: Essential cookies keep you signed in and remember your country and language. With your consent we also load Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity to understand how the site is used, Meta Pixel to measure our advertising, and Doctify to show patient reviews — these set their own cookies. See our
cookie.necessaryBody: Your sign-in session, language and country preference. The site cannot work without these.
cookie.marketingBody: Meta Pixel — tells us which adverts bring patients to us.
cookie.thirdPartyBody: Doctify patient-review widgets (doctify.com) and the ElevenLabs voice assistant (elevenlabs.io) — the assistant uses your microphone only while you are talking to it.
cookie.analyticsBody: Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity (session replay) — show us which pages are useful and where the site is confusing. Page addresses are stripped of anything that could identify you, and neither runs on booking, cart, checkout, upload or verification pages.
cookie.doctifyBlockedBody: Reviews are loaded from Doctify, which sets its own cookies.
